meaningfulChallenges.topic: Phone cause and improved visibility are different findings
meaningfulChallenges.response: I independently found the same eye-line/source mismatch. The larger portrait moth improves the visibility of existing anatomy, but does not make the question lie on the authored reading axis. Keep the moderate deduction and avoid converting better visibility into narrative-resolution approval.

Sound A deducts for the small mitten remaining near the collar and therefore reading as generic welcome. That is a valid bounded still-image judgment. My sampled sequence reading gives the return-to-viewer beat more contextual credit, so I did not independently deduct that ambiguity. Neither reading proves unprimed comprehension. The proposal preserves hand specificity as unfinished craft, which accommodates both judgments without score averaging.

Agree with A that absence of a soundtrack is not missing functionality. Do not use the sound role to require mute controls when no audio exists. If sound is later requested, pressing the existing silent Play control alone is not an opt-in to future sound; establish a separate reversible choice.

The newer active-only Thinking sample has 119 intervals, mean 34.45 ms, p95 35 ms, max 67 ms, and four over 50 ms. It narrows the previous mixed-idle observation, without proving perceived rhythm, phone performance or attributing older one-second gaps to SVG.

evidenceBasedResolution: Accept the bounded implemented local foundation. Preserve silent operation, finite playback, intentional rests, reduced-motion stills, and the owner-selected lead. Carry the phone cue relationship and hand specificity forward as unresolved craft. No additional audio is necessary for acceptance.

remainingDisagreements.position: Sound B remains 8.5; Sound A is 8.6. The endpoint ambiguity is more consequential in A's assessment. These are separate scoped judgments, not a substantive objection to the bounded proposal.

acceptedJointRecommendation: Keep motion silent and self-contained. Optional future audio should reinforce an already readable visual cause, never mask the unresolved phone eyeline relation.
practicalSkillsWorkflowAgreement: Create a cause map and authored timeline first: stimulus → antenna/gaze lead → head/hand support → settle. Mark project text, background and transports static unless a useful change justifies feedback.

Use remove-animations frequency/purpose reasoning on interface feedback and repeated attention demands. Keep finite intentionally requested performance; preserve static initialization and indefinite held endings.
For future engineering reviews, exercise interruption and hidden/offscreen cancellation during playback and between collection clips. Do not restart automatically on return.

Capture actual desktop and portrait notice/read/return evidence at intended size. Keep source timing, sampled frames, continuous perception, physical-device behavior and human comfort in separate evidence categories.

Audio review begins only if commissioned and after visual cause is sound. Require explicit reversible opt-in and event-based sparse cues with no overlapping or catch-up playback; obtain actual repeated-listening evidence before an audio comfort claim.
exceptions: Keep keyboard access to content Play; do not misapply the ban on decorative keyboard-triggered UI animation.
Keep narrative duration separate from sub-300 ms interface budgets.
Preserve expressive SVG anatomy and equal day/night numeric poses; profile actual workloads before simplifying non-compositor animation.
Read-only review uses JSON rather than executing remove-animations edits or its standalone Markdown template.
No React Native/Swift/Sonner implementation is justified by catalog awareness.
limits: No audio was heard or supplied.
No continuous motion watched; contact sheets and source only.
No fresh human, physical-phone, spoken-AT or repeat-visit validation.
